resolution: Investigated the Desk.glb collision report after the screenshot. The imported kind was already carrying the measured 2.309897m by 1.149652m footprint, so this was not bad GLB collision data. I fixed the compiled loader path by centralizing imported mesh collider packing and re-emitting imported prop oriented colliders during spatial-window collider rebuilds, so the desk keeps the measured rectangular footprint after the runtime swaps into near-field collision mode. Verified with Zig ast-check, world map/gamefile tests, and the hmsc-int bundle.
